verdict.rationale: YYLO is a coding-agent orchestrator, so automated security-alert remediation is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions ingesting security alerts, validating them, or opening pull requests. The closest items are bringing GitHub issues or Slack messages into kanban and landing merges through its own protected merge flow, which are adjacent features rather than security-alert remediation via PR.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have security alerts automatically validated and remediated with an opened pull request
